correctness.rationale: For q any prime power and n>=4, every nonzero rank-one strictly upper-triangular matrix has unique normalized projective chart indexed by last nonzero coordinate k of u and first nonzero coordinate l of v, k<l. The chart count is R_n=Σ_{h=0}^{n-2}(h+1)q^h. Summing all nonzero scalar multiples gives the exact integer W(B)=1-R_n+qZ_n(B), with Z number of projective chart points whose additive pairing vanishes. Any chart with at least two variables in one group contributes a multiple of q; the four corner charts yield modulo q counts 1 when a=B_1n=0 and 0+1+1-1 when a≠0, hence Z≡1 mod q. Therefore W≡-q (mod q²) is never zero and has p-adic valuation r for q=p^r. Exact n2 and n3 zero frequency counts establish sharp n4 threshold. Independently enumerated q2 n4 all 18 cone points, all 64 Fourier eigenvalues from direct signs, verifying residue 2 mod4 and no zero. Finite enumeration does not establish universal q,n, which is supplied by projective-chart proof.
